title: Listening Drill — City hall hearing route
description: Directions dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: City hall hearing route
sections.transcript:
VISITOR: I'm trying to get to the council hearing. My map shows two possible routes. Which one would you recommend?

ASSISTANT: Start at the public entrance. From there, walk towards the information board. Stay on the same side until you can see the sign for the assembly room.

VISITOR: Can I go through the middle? It looks a lot shorter on the map.

ASSISTANT: I'd avoid the main staircase today. Only staff can use it this week. If you're meeting a group, wait by the sign so they can spot you.
